A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Good work starts
with curiosity.

A developer’s logic. A designer’s eye.

I’m a Business Information Systems undergraduate at the University of Sri Jayewardenepura, pursuing a BSc (Hons) in Business Information Systems (Special)

With an interest in UI/UX design, business analysis, and technology, I enjoy understanding user needs, exploring ideas, and turning complex problems into simple, intuitive solutions. I believe great digital products are built where creativity, usability, and purpose come together.

I’m always curious to learn, experiment with new ideas, and grow as a designer and technology professional.
